about_the_game:
Embark on a journey through the soundscape of Vivid World.

Composed by Ryosuke Kojima, K. Matsuoka and various artists from Vivid Knight, 

this soundtrack brings to life the emotions, colors, and memories of wandering Spirits.

From serene melodies echoing through quiet forests to pulsing battle rhythms,

every note captures the contrast of light and shadow that defines Vivid World.

Experience the full collection of in-game tracks and

let the echoes of your adventure linger in your heart.
